body:
I do have some ideas, but having templates involved makes them very hacky.

One thing that can be done is after a search, display div or img without src with a placeholder or a color computed in the resultset and then with a delay of some hundreds of ms, update the src or add the image.

Also we could only load the image that are in the viewport.

But honestly I think that could be a different hit widget. ImageHit that could have a template for some rendering of texts, but not for the image which could be only ours to handle.

@vvo it's not that hard, the time for image loading is not expected to be instant so we can without a problem add a few 100's ms (like 200 or 300) which will be enough to know if there is an other keystroke.
